title: npm distribution targets
description: Platforms actionlint publishes a prebuilt npm package for, and the GoReleaser release asset each one is cut from.

facade.description: npm name of the user-facing package. Platform packages are named "<facade>-<pkg>".

binary.description: Executable inside each release archive, without any .exe suffix.

pkg.description: npm name suffix. Must equal "<os>-<cpu>": the launcher derives the package name that way, so any other value publishes a package it can never resolve.

os.description: Node process.platform value, used as the package's "os" field.

cpu.description: Node process.arch value, used as the package's "cpu" field.

asset.description: GOOS_GOARCH pair as it appears in the release asset name, e.g. "linux_amd64". ARM builds carry the variant, e.g. "linux_armv6".

format.description: Archive format GoReleaser publishes for this platform.

tier.description: 1 for platforms covered by CI, 2 for best-effort builds.
